mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 200.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand strength, which increases corporate revenue visibility and supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in joint regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average indicates weakening supply-side capacity utilization, which signals an impending economic slowdown and triggers risk-off behavior, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 103.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 3.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising FEDFUNDS rate, indicates persistent inflationary pressure that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, increasing real rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both CPIAUCSL > 3.5 and FEDFUNDS >= 0.2, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below its 6-month moving average, combined with a decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized, signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS < 660000.0 and GDPC1 < 1.0, or the joint effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5%, combined with strong payroll growth (PAYEMS > 200k), indicates a labor market that is overheating, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE < 3.5 and PAYEMS > 200.0, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 103.0, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 3.8%, indicates a supply-side contraction coupled with labor market weakness, signaling a recessionary risk that triggers equity sell-offs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO < 103.0 and UNRATE > 3.8, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).
